name: Online maps and navigation
how: Satellite and aerial imagery, GPS, cloud data centres, tiled web rendering; turn-by-turn routing over live traffic
impact: Used by about two billion people a month to find places and get around; paper maps and standalone satnavs largely gone.

name: Mobile broadband (3G data)
how: Mobile phone network, packet radio, compressed media; ★ spread-spectrum code-division radio (CDMA)
impact: Put the internet in most adults' pockets: today over five billion people get online mainly over cellular data.
why: A new generation of the mobile-phone network, but it changed what the phone does (internet, not just calls), so I hedged under m4.

name: Camera phone
how: CMOS image sensor, mobile phone, flash memory; ★ active-pixel sensor (CMOS) the board probably lacks
impact: Over a trillion photos a year are now taken on phones; it ended the film and compact-camera era and made everyone a photographer and witness.
why: Digital camera plus mobile phone put together, but it changed who takes pictures and how they're shared; m4 says borderline.

name: Utility-scale solar power
how: Mass-produced crystalline-silicon photovoltaic panels, inverters, tracking mounts
impact: Solar went from a niche to roughly 7% of world electricity and the cheapest new power in most countries.
why: Photovoltaic cells (1954) are in the deck; cheap panels on the grid changed who uses it (whole power systems, not satellites), so borderline under m4.

name: Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine
how: Polysaccharide-protein conjugate, vaccination
impact: Given to most of the world's babies; prevents a leading cause of child pneumonia and meningitis deaths.

name: Text messaging
how: Mobile phone network, signalling channel, later internet messaging apps
impact: Billions of people send short messages every day; it changed how people coordinate everything from dates to protests.
why: SMS was first sent in 1992 and is arguably part of the Mobile phone card; mass use came around 2000 and apps followed in 2009, so check the date and whether it's distinct.

name: Machine translation
how: Statistical (later neural) language models trained on bilingual text, cloud data centres
impact: Over half a billion people a month translate text, signs and speech for free.

name: Rotavirus vaccine
how: Live attenuated oral vaccine, vaccination
impact: In the schedules of 100+ countries; cuts deaths from the leading cause of severe child diarrhoea.

name: Online encyclopedia (wiki)
how: Web pages anyone can edit, revision history, volunteer moderation
impact: Wikipedia is among the ten most visited websites, read by billions and the reference behind search and AI answers.
why: The Encyclopedia (1751) is in the deck; moved online and written by anyone, it changed who writes and reads it, so borderline under m4.

name: Kinase-inhibitor cancer drugs
how: Small molecules that block a mutated signalling enzyme; ★ targeted inhibition of a cancer's driver protein
impact: Turned some leukaemias into chronic conditions and started targeted cancer therapy, now a large share of cancer drugs.

name: App store
how: Smartphone, online shopping, mobile payments, code signing
impact: Billions of people install software through phone app stores; it created the mobile app economy.
why: It's more a distribution business than a device; is it an invention?

name: GPU computing
how: Graphics processors with thousands of parallel cores, general-purpose programming toolkit
impact: The hardware that deep learning, LLMs and supercomputing run on; one of the most valuable industries of the 2020s.

name: HPV vaccine
how: Virus-like particles made in yeast, vaccination; ★ self-assembling virus-like particles
impact: Given to hundreds of millions of girls (and boys); expected to nearly eliminate cervical cancer where coverage is high.

name: Artemisinin combination therapy
how: Artemisinin malaria drug plus a slower partner drug
impact: The standard malaria cure worldwide; hundreds of millions of courses a year and a large share of the malaria deaths averted since 2000.
why: A pairing of the artemisinin drug that's already kept; it changed how well the drug works (resistance protection), so borderline under m4.

name: Electronic cigarette
how: Lithium-ion battery, heating coil, nicotine solution; ★ aerosol made by flash-boiling liquid on a wick
impact: About 80-100 million vapers worldwide; it reshaped how people smoke and quit.

name: Broadband internet (DSL and cable)
how: Copper phone lines or TV cable, modems; ★ discrete multitone modulation over twisted pair
impact: Took home internet from dial-up to always-on, which video, cloud and online work depend on.
why: A faster way to reach the existing Internet; it changed how it's used (always on, video), so I hedged under m4.

name: Search advertising
how: Search engine, auction pricing per click, user data
impact: Funds most of the free web; online ads are now over half of all ad spending.
why: Invention or business? Pay-per-click was tried in 1998; AdWords made it the norm in 2000-2002.

name: OLED display
how: Thin-film transistors, organic semiconductor layers; ★ organic electroluminescence
impact: In most premium phones, watches and TVs: billions of screens a year.

name: Electric bicycle
how: Bicycle, electric motor, lead-acid or lithium-ion battery
impact: Hundreds of millions in use, mostly in China; the main way many urban commuters travel.

name: Direct oral anticoagulants
how: Small molecules that block a single clotting factor; ★ direct inhibition of a clotting enzyme
impact: Tens of millions take them daily against stroke and clots; they replaced warfarin and its blood tests.

name: Smart electricity meter
how: Microchip, meter, two-way communication over power lines or radio
impact: About a billion installed; utilities bill remotely and price power by the hour.

name: Ready-to-use therapeutic food
how: Peanut paste, milk powder, vitamins and minerals in a sealed packet
impact: Treats millions of starving children a year at home instead of in hospital, with cure rates above 90%.

name: Multi-touch screen
how: Capacitive touchscreen, gesture software; mutual-capacitance sensing grid
impact: On every smartphone and tablet; pinch and swipe became how billions use computers.
why: A version of the Capacitive touchscreen card; it changed how it's used (many fingers, no stylus), so borderline under m4.

name: Music streaming
how: Compressed media, cloud data centres, licensing, recommendation algorithms
impact: Over 700 million subscribers; now most of the music industry's revenue.
why: Same thing as the kept Streaming video card, applied to music.

name: Drug-eluting stent
how: Coronary stent coated with a cell-growth-blocking drug in a polymer
impact: Millions implanted each year; it made stenting the default over bypass surgery for many patients.
why: A version of the Coronary stent; the drug coating changed how it works (no re-narrowing), so borderline under m4.

name: Podcasting
how: Compressed media, web feeds, portable music player
impact: Hundreds of millions of people listen to podcasts every week.

name: Machine-learning spam filter
how: Email, statistical classifier trained on users' marked mail
impact: Blocks most of the world's email, which is spam; without it email would be unusable.

name: Biometric passport
how: Contactless card chip, photo and fingerprint data, public-key encryption
impact: Over a billion in circulation; the basis of automated border gates.

name: Lithium iron phosphate battery
how: Lithium-ion battery with an iron-phosphate cathode
impact: Now in roughly half of new electric cars and most grid batteries, because it's cheap and doesn't catch fire easily.
why: A chemistry change to the Lithium-ion battery; it changed who can afford it (cheap cars, grid storage), so borderline under m4.

name: Distributed version control
how: Hashes of file contents, merge algorithms, the Internet
impact: The standard way software is built; over 100 million developers use it daily.

name: USB flash drive
how: Flash memory, USB connector
impact: Replaced floppy disks and CDs for carrying files; billions sold.
why: Flash memory in a pocket stick; it changed how people carried files, but it's now fading, so hedged under m4.

name: Electronic voting machine
how: Microchips, keypad, sealed memory, results sent over the network
impact: Used by Brazil's and India's whole electorates, close to a billion voters.

name: GPS auto-steer tractor
how: Tractor, GPS with ground correction signals, hydraulic steering
impact: Steers most large-farm tractors in rich countries, cutting overlap, fuel and fertiliser.
why: GPS put on the Tractor; changed how farming works (precision agriculture), so borderline under m4.

name: GPS-guided bomb kit
how: Precision-guided bomb, GPS, inertial navigation, strap-on tail fins
impact: Made almost every bomb dropped since 2001 precise in any weather, cheaply.
why: A version of the kept Precision-guided bombs (first used 1999, routine from 2001); GPS made it cheap and usable in any weather.

name: Long-acting insulin
how: Insulin with altered amino acids made by genetic engineering; slow release from the injection site
impact: Tens of millions with diabetes use it once a day instead of several unpredictable doses.
why: A modified form of Insulin (1921); it changed how it's dosed, so borderline under m4.

name: Anti-VEGF eye injections
how: Monoclonal antibodies injected into the eye that stop leaky blood-vessel growth
impact: The leading reason age-related macular degeneration no longer usually causes blindness; millions of injections a year.
why: A use of the kept Monoclonal antibodies; new target and route of delivery, so borderline under m4.

name: CAPTCHA
how: Distorted text or image puzzles a computer can't yet solve, website login
impact: Hundreds of millions solved each day; it kept bots off sign-ups and helped digitise books.

name: Fitness tracker
how: Accelerometer, lithium-ion battery, short-range wireless link, phone app
impact: Hundreds of millions wear step and heart-rate trackers, now mostly in smartwatches.
why: Around the decade's cut, and the 2015 smartwatch overshadows it.

name: Off-grid solar lighting
how: Small photovoltaic panel, white LED, lithium-ion battery
impact: Gives light and phone charging to roughly half a billion people without grid power.
why: Solar panel plus LED at a tiny scale; it changed who has electric light, so borderline under m4 and around the cut.

name: Peer-to-peer file sharing
how: Internet, compressed media, swarms of users' computers sharing pieces of each file
impact: At its peak a third of internet traffic; it broke the music industry's business model.
why: Huge in 2005 but mostly replaced by streaming; around the cut.

name: Robot vacuum cleaner
how: Vacuum cleaner, bump and infrared sensors, rechargeable battery, mapping software
impact: Tens of millions of homes; the first home robot most people own.
why: The Vacuum cleaner made autonomous; it changed how it works, so borderline under m4.

name: Surgical safety checklist
how: A one-page checklist and a team pause before surgery
impact: Used in thousands of hospitals worldwide; cut surgical deaths by about a third in trials.
why: A practice rather than a device, and around the decade's cut.

name: E-reader
how: Microchips, wireless link, online shopping; ★ electrophoretic display (electronic paper)
impact: Tens of millions of devices; made e-books a fifth to a third of book sales in some markets.
why: Not in most people's daily lives; included for the electronic paper effect.

name: Noise-cancelling headphones
how: Microphone, loudspeaker, signal processing; ★ destructive interference of sound
impact: Now standard in hundreds of millions of headphones and earbuds.
why: Bose sold aviation sets in 1989 and consumer ones in 2000; popular, but only recently everyday.

name: High-frequency trading
how: Computers in exchange data centres, fast fibre and microwave links, trading algorithms
impact: About half of US stock trades; it shrank trading costs and changed how markets work.
why: Invention or business? It's also invisible to most people.

name: Earthquake early warning
how: Seismometer network, fast detection of the first P-wave, phone and TV alerts
impact: Japan since 2007; now in Android phones worldwide, warning billions seconds before shaking.
why: Around the decade's cut; the global phone version came only in 2020.

name: CubeSat
how: Standard 10 cm satellite modules, off-the-shelf electronics, shared rocket launches
impact: Thousands launched; universities, start-ups and small countries reached orbit cheaply.
why: A smaller Communications/Earth satellite; it changed who can launch one, so borderline under m4.

name: Transcatheter heart valve
how: Collapsible valve on a stent, catheter
impact: Hundreds of thousands a year get a new heart valve without open-heart surgery.
why: Below the decade's cut.

name: Bike sharing
how: Bicycle, smart-card or phone unlocking, docking stations
impact: Hundreds of cities, especially in China and Europe.
why: Below the decade's cut, and more a service than an invention.

name: Genomic selection in livestock
how: DNA chips reading thousands of markers, statistical breeding values
impact: Now how most dairy bulls are chosen; doubled the rate of genetic gain.
why: Below the decade's cut; invisible to most people.

name: Mine-resistant armoured vehicle
how: V-shaped armoured hull, truck chassis
impact: Tens of thousands built; cut IED deaths in Iraq and Afghanistan.
why: Below the decade's cut; a version of armoured vehicles.

name: Buprenorphine addiction treatment
how: Partial opioid agonist taken from a doctor's office instead of a clinic
impact: Millions treated for opioid addiction.
why: Below the decade's cut; methadone did the same job earlier.

name: Flex-fuel car
how: Car, ethanol sensor, adjustable fuel injection
impact: Most new cars in Brazil run on any ethanol-gasoline mix.
why: Below the decade's cut; mostly one country.

name: Shingles vaccine
how: Live attenuated (later protein) vaccine, vaccination
impact: Given to tens of millions of older adults.
why: Below the decade's cut.

name: Automatic number-plate recognition
how: Cameras, optical character recognition, vehicle databases
impact: Runs congestion charges, tolls and police tracking in many countries.
why: Below the decade's cut; the cameras existed from the 1970s.

name: Airport body scanner
how: Millimetre-wave radio imaging, software that flags objects
impact: Hundreds of millions of travellers screened a year.
why: Below the decade's cut.

name: Online video sharing
how: Compressed media, cloud data centres, web browser
impact: Billions watch user-uploaded video.
why: Same as the kept Streaming video (2005) card.

name: Internet phone calls (VoIP)
how: Internet, compressed media, microphone
impact: Most phone calls now travel as internet packets.
why: Covered by the kept Video calling (2003) card.

name: International Space Station
how: Space station modules, solar panels, docking
impact: Continuously crewed since 2000.
why: Same job, same way as Space station (1971); just bigger.

name: Armed drone
how: Military drone, laser-guided missile
impact: Changed how wars are fought, from Afghanistan to Ukraine.
why: Covered by Military drones (1995); same aircraft with a missile.

name: Flat-panel TV
how: Liquid crystal display, LED backlight
impact: Replaced the tube TV in almost every home.
why: The Liquid crystal display made larger; same job, same way.

name: Offshore wind farm
how: Wind turbines on sea-floor foundations, subsea cables
impact: Supplies a sizeable share of power in the UK, Denmark and China.
why: Wind turbine put somewhere new; same job, same way.

name: 4G mobile network
how: Mobile broadband, OFDM radio, all-IP core
impact: Carries most of the world's mobile data.
why: A faster version of Mobile broadband; same job, same way.

name: Solid-state drive
how: Flash memory, controller chip
impact: Replaced hard disks in most laptops.
why: Flash memory as a disk; same job, same way.

name: Server virtualization
how: Hypervisor software, x86 servers
impact: Lets one server run many machines; underpins cloud computing.
why: Part of the kept Cloud data centres card.

name: PET-CT scanner
how: PET scanner and CAT scan in one gantry
impact: Standard for cancer staging.
why: Two cards already on the board in one machine; same job.

name: Capsule endoscopy
how: Swallowed camera pill, radio link
impact: Used for small-bowel exams.
why: Niche medical tool.

name: Cosmetic botulinum injections
how: Botulinum toxin injected into facial muscles
impact: Millions of procedures a year.
why: Not in most people's daily lives.
